metadata.description: CopilotForge: your Microsoft AI transformation team as installable AI skills.

plugins.name: copilotforge-ai-strategy
plugins.description: CopilotForge AI Strategy. Define the organisation's AI ambition, target outcomes, principles, operating model and roadmap, starting from business outcomes rather than products.

plugins.name: copilotforge-opportunity-management
plugins.description: CopilotForge Opportunity Management. Create a disciplined path from business problem to prioritised and governed initiative, including the decision about whether AI is the right answer at all.

plugins.name: copilotforge-value-realisation
plugins.description: CopilotForge Value Realisation. Define baselines, measures and ownership so adoption and deployed solutions create demonstrable value.

plugins.name: copilotforge-programme-management
plugins.description: CopilotForge Programme Management. Mobilise and govern a coherent adoption, delivery or transformation programme.

plugins.name: copilotforge-copilot-adoption
plugins.description: CopilotForge Copilot Adoption. Design and run organisation-wide or business-unit Microsoft AI adoption programmes, from readiness and scenarios through launch, reinforcement and measurement.

plugins.name: copilotforge-champions
plugins.description: CopilotForge Champions. Create evidence-led Champion programmes that turn curiosity into capability and capability into contribution, with clear boundaries on what Champions do and do not do.

plugins.name: copilotforge-learning-and-skills
plugins.description: CopilotForge Learning and Skills. Create role-based learning, practice, assessment and progression pathways.

plugins.name: copilotforge-change-and-communications
plugins.description: CopilotForge Change and Communications. Build sponsorship, communications, manager engagement, behavioural reinforcement and change readiness.

plugins.name: copilotforge-knowledge-management
plugins.description: CopilotForge Knowledge Management. Make organisational knowledge discoverable, owned, current, classified and suitable for AI grounding.

plugins.name: copilotforge-m365-copilot
plugins.description: CopilotForge Microsoft 365 Copilot. Help organisations introduce Microsoft Copilot as an everyday working capability.

plugins.name: copilotforge-m365-agents
plugins.description: CopilotForge Microsoft 365 Agents. Turn organisational knowledge and repeatable information needs into appropriately scoped, owned and tested agents with a managed lifecycle.

plugins.name: copilotforge-copilot-cowork
plugins.description: CopilotForge Copilot Cowork. Design safe, effective delegation of complex work with explicit context, checkpoints and review.

plugins.name: copilotforge-copilot-code
plugins.description: CopilotForge Copilot Code. Translate desired outcomes into governed software prototypes and production-ready engineering work.

plugins.name: copilotforge-copilot-studio
plugins.description: CopilotForge Copilot Studio. Design and deliver low-code and enterprise agents with appropriate actions, data, ALM and lifecycle controls.

plugins.name: copilotforge-ai-foundry
plugins.description: CopilotForge Microsoft Foundry. Engineer specialist and custom AI solutions where configured agents are insufficient.

plugins.name: copilotforge-automation
plugins.description: CopilotForge Automation. Combine AI with deterministic workflow automation where repeatability and integration matter.

plugins.name: copilotforge-ai-engineering
plugins.description: CopilotForge AI Engineering. Provide pro-code engineering patterns shared across custom AI solutions.

plugins.name: copilotforge-ai-architecture
plugins.description: CopilotForge AI Architecture. Select appropriate patterns and define target architecture across Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure and data services.

plugins.name: copilotforge-security-privacy
plugins.description: CopilotForge Security and Privacy. Reviewer-class department that assesses identity, access, data exposure, connectors, privacy and retention for AI solutions and blocks release while material risks are unresolved.

plugins.name: copilotforge-responsible-ai
plugins.description: CopilotForge Responsible AI. Reviewer-class department that identifies impact, accountability, human oversight, unacceptable uses and mitigating controls.

plugins.name: copilotforge-data-governance
plugins.description: CopilotForge Data Governance. Ensure the data used by AI is appropriately owned, classified, accessible, lawful and of sufficient quality.

plugins.name: copilotforge-evaluation-quality
plugins.description: CopilotForge Evaluation and Quality. Reviewer-class department that defines evaluation sets, acceptance criteria, failure analysis and release evidence for probabilistic systems.

plugins.name: copilotforge-platform-governance
plugins.description: CopilotForge Platform Governance. Govern environments, makers, connectors, agents, deployment, licensing and portfolio visibility.

plugins.name: copilotforge-ai-operations
plugins.description: CopilotForge AI Operations. Operate deployed agents and AI solutions throughout support, monitoring, review, improvement and retirement.

plugins.name: copilotforge-design-authority
plugins.description: CopilotForge Design Authority. Reviewer-class department that challenges inappropriate platform choice, unnecessary AI, fragile architecture and unsupportable designs.

plugins.name: copilotforge-ai-centre-of-excellence
plugins.description: CopilotForge AI Centre of Excellence. Orchestrate a business-owned AI Centre of Excellence covering charter, operating model, team, governance, opportunity flow, knowledge, cadence, RACI and value measurement.

plugins.name: copilotforge-organisation-tailoring
plugins.description: CopilotForge Organisation Tailoring. Turn an organisation profile into a recommended edition and maturity archetype, a scaled programme, an ownership map and a transformation pack.
